full_judgment: 3. The facts leading to issuance of the rule in brief, are that the petitioner Ali Mia instituted C.R. Case No. 1331 of 1978 on the allegation that the accused persons forcibly cut and took away his jute grown by him in plot No. 2185 appertaining to Khatian No.95 of Mouza Jalan in the District of Comilla in spite of protest by the complainant. The case was fixed for examination of prosecution witnesses on 21-9-78. On that date the complainant did not attend the Court. He filed a petition through his lawyer praying for time on the ground of his illness. As no medical certificate could be produced in support of the petition for time the learned Magistrate took the view that the charge against the accused persons was groundless and he discharged the accused opposite parties under section 253(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
